title: Inside the Iran war decision making: NYT describes how Trump chose to go to war
summary: An exclusive report published in the New York Times, with the title 'How Trump Took the U.S. to War With Iran' outlines how, in the run up to the Iran war, President Trump weighed his instincts to go to war against the deep concerns of his vice president and also a pessimistic intelligence assessment. FRANCE 24's International Affairs Editor Kethevane Gorje…
